title: Static Configuration
description: Specifies a static configuration of the signal processing to run on a device.

session.title: Session
session.description: Specify property settings for the DSP system as a whole.

property_settings.title: Property Settings
property_settings.description: An array of property settings for the DSP system.

tasks.title: Task Specifications
tasks.description: An array of specifications for the tasks running on this device.

task_connections.title: Task Connection Specifications
task_connections.description: An array of specifications for signal connections between tasks, or between tasks and system I/O.

parameter_settings.title: Parameter Setting Specifications
parameter_settings.description: An array of specifications for parameter settings for the blocks in this device.

task.title: Signal Processing Task Specification
task.description: Specifications for a real-time task's property settings and the blocks running within the task.

name.title: Task Name
name.description: The name of the task, which must be unique among all tasks in the device.

property_settings.title: Property Settings
property_settings.description: An array of property settings for the task.

blocks.title: Block Specifications
blocks.description: An array of specifications for the blocks running within this task.

block_connections.title: Block Connection Specifications
block_connections.description: An array of specifications for signal connections between blocks.

block.title: Signal Processing Block Specification
block.description: The static configuration of a signal processing block including its parameter settings, terminal channel counts, and signal connections.

name.title: Block Name
name.description: The name of the block, which must be unique among all blocks in the system.

algorithm.title: Algorithm Name
algorithm.description: The name of the block, which must be unique among all blocks in the system.

property_settings.title: Property Settings
property_settings.description: An array of property settings for the block.

terminal_channels.title: Terminal Channels
terminal_channels.description: An array of specifications for the number of channels of terminals in the block.
